description: This file defines the 'Probe' class and its nested classes, which implement a network discovery and communication mechanism using Web requests over UDP datagrams. It includes classes for transforming Web requests, listening for incoming requests, broadcasting discovery messages, and managing probe instances with network endpoints.

classes.name: Probe
classes.description: Main class implementing network probe functionality, including broadcasting, listening, and managing instances.

classes.name: Probe::WebTransform
classes.description: Handles transformation of Web requests for the probe.

classes.name: Probe::Listener
classes.description: Listens for incoming Web requests and responses over UDP datagrams.

classes.name: Probe::Broadcaster
classes.description: Sends out discovery messages over UDP datagrams.

classes.name: Probe::Instance
classes.description: Represents a network endpoint with URL, latency, model, and security status.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Transforms Web request data into a socket buffer.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a body to a partial Web request.

methods.name: CreateResponse
methods.description: Creates a Web response based on incoming request.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping message to discover network peers.
